cursor.standing: VOCABULARY RENAMED to pass BUILD-TO-THE-TOOL (Akien's naming gate, 2026-07-25): a term must be DERIVABLE from its native-domain use — know how the word works on the water and its meaning here follows, with nothing to memorise. Four terms failed and were retired: `in_flight` (an AVIATION word inside a nautical system — a ship is never in flight), `berth_pending` (invented, not a maritime term), `docked` (a near-SYNONYM of berth, so nothing told a reader which of ours was which), and `journey` (which already meant CC's SESSION TRANSCRIPT elsewhere in this tree — one word, two meanings). Replaced by the real vessel progression AT SEA -> AT ANCHOR -> BERTHED, one continuous sequence any sailor knows, mapping exactly onto voyaging / arrived-awaiting-a-berth / tied-up-at-rest. `underway` SURVIVES on a different axis: at-sea is WHERE a boat is, under-way is THAT it is making normal progress (the calm unflagged count inside a gate) — the collision that killed the first proposal (`in_flight`->`under_way`) and was caught by reading before renaming. Net -3 names (falsifier 10 on bus-completion: a build adds no net new vocabulary). THIS COMPONENT: journey.py -> voyage.py, proofs/test_journey.py -> proofs/test_voyage.py, journey_of -> voyage_of, mid_journey -> mid_voyage; traffic_image now returns {gates, at_anchor, berthed, counts{at_sea, at_anchor, gates, flagged, berthed, fleet}}. NOTE FOR THE TRAIL: the sealed record validations/test_journey.json names a proof file that no longer exists — it is an honest record of a proof that ran under the FORMER name and is deliberately NOT rewritten (a record of truth never changes in place, Law 7); this entry is the link between the two names.

window.standing: child c BUILT — the TRAFFIC IMAGE (journey.py): the harbour master's state-right-now main view, composed as DATA over the register (child a). Two derived, computed-on-read structures: the EMERGENT GATE (in-flight boats grouped by transition-class — many workflows share one gate) and the JOURNEY STITCH (a boat's open + berthed vantages joined across the hyphen/underscore id-spelling, register filed-edge e). The one honest flag today is MID-JOURNEY (a boat at sea AND docked — the silently-stuck, the boon of the broad view); the rest of the marker vocabulary is filed grow-against-need on the gate's-queue IOU (held-traffic-image). Owns nothing (a projection over the register, Law 7).

child c PROVEN — and the harbor_master PARENT proves with it (child c was the last rung). 4 teeth a hollow view could not pass: the emergent gate is SHARED (a gate holds >1 boat over the real fleet, non-hollow, Law 8); the journey STITCHES a boat's two vantages across id-spelling and flags the silently-stuck (mid-journey boats actually surface — the boon); the image OWNS NOTHING (each occupant byte-equal to its register entry, gates exactly the open set, Law 7); the calm/flagged partition is exact per gate. Sealed under a REAL netns (green/sealed). Live: 12 in flight across 7 gates, 4 flagged mid-journey, 9 docked.

child c SHARPENED — the fleet count is now HONEST without moving a file (Law 1, read-side). Added the BERTH-PENDING condition [✓]: a boat in the open lane whose cursor is at a REST (PROVED) is DONE awaiting its physical berth — it leaves the in-flight count and the gates entirely, read straight off the cursor the register already parses. This sets DONE-but-unberthed boats apart from work genuinely in flight (the migration debt: a PROVED ticket still in CairnCommons/tickets/ because the auto-berther has not run). Sharpens mid-journey [~] — a both-lanes boat AT REST is berth-pending, not silently-stuck; the flag now fires only for in-workflow both-lanes boats. 5th tooth added (berth-pending is done + off the gates); the stitch tooth de-brittled to pick its subjects from the live fleet. Re-sealed under a REAL netns (green/sealed). Honest live read: 8 in flight across 6 gates (2 flagged mid-journey), 4 berth-pending, 9 docked.

BERTHED — the harbor's own ticket voyage froze into this history and CairnCommons/tickets/harbor-master.json migrated out of the open lane beside its code (the physical berth the register+journey were built to make honest; Law 5). The reflexive register proof + the transitions real-ticket proof were de-brittled to invariants (no longer pinning harbor-master as an OPEN boat) so this move is green, not red. berth-pending -> 0.
